resources.string: Select one photo and choose three creative presets, or select 2–9 matching photos for sequence tools and eye/smile analysis. Outputs are independent rendered JPEGs up to 2048 pixels; originals stay intact. Keep a tripod for stacks and composites. Alignment and classification can fail; review results. Super resolution needs at least four independently shifted frames.
New JPEG outputs saved in the app gallery.
